 P.S.TO JUDGE rs.
 P.B.SURESH KUMAR, J.
Dated this the 12th day of August, 2016.
J U D G M E N T

The limited prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner is for a direction to the first respondent to consider Ext.P9 representation submitted by the petitioner for release of the food grains seized from him.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition directing the first respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P9 representation within three weeks from today, after affording an opportunity for hearing to the petitioner.
Needless to say that until a final decision is taken on Ext.P9, the food grains referred to therein shall not be distributed.
Ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
P.B.SURESH KUMAR, JUDGE.
Kvs/-
